description: Defines schemas and registration API for backend interfaces in PyTorch JIT, including functions for checking availability, compiling, and executing backends.

classes.name: backend
classes.description: Template class for registering a backend with the JIT, including methods to define backend functions.

methods.name: getIsAvailableSchema
methods.description: Creates a schema for the 'is_available' method.

methods.name: getCompileSchema
methods.description: Creates a schema for the 'compile' method.

methods.name: getExecuteSchema
methods.description: Creates a schema for the 'execute' method.

methods.name: getIsAvailableFunc
methods.description: Returns a function that checks if a backend is available.

methods.name: getCompileFunc
methods.description: Returns a function that compiles a backend.

methods.name: getExecuteFunc
methods.description: Returns a function that executes a backend.
